name: X Championship
epitaph: Held by NoMaD across the two April 2006 episodes served this pass, contested for by Scorpio; the record does not attest when or how the title changed hands before or after.

name: MWA World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Held by Kevin Frost as of the promotion's own 50th episode of Turmoil in June 2006, non-title against Scorpio; the record does not attest when or how he won it.
